brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.
costSource: token-equivalent at Muse Spark Open shared rates, info only: the Dedicated Endpoint bills GPU seconds while up (.spend/modal-dedicated.jsonl)

requirements.evidence: Four bases in a straight line: piece:-1,0,0;full, piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:2,0,0;full, each fitted with a bin (bin:-1,0,0~hex-bin-third-drain etc.) filled with soil and planted, forming four planter cells.

requirements.requirement: Water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell
requirements.evidence: Single pipe run run:run-1 at level 0 starts at q -1,0 entryEdge 3 and passes through q 0,0 → 1,0 → 2,0, so the pipe physically traverses the base of every cell. Caps and joint bolts added to close open faces. Third-depth drained bins used because a straight through-run only leaves third-depth clearance.

finish.summary: Built a 4-cell linear planter (-1,0 to 2,0) with a continuous water pipe run through the bases of all four cells. Each cell holds a third-depth drained bin with soil and seedlings, demonstrating the irrigation-fed planter purpose. Open faces capped and joints locked; mesh check is clear.

lines.label: M6 x 25 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.

Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
